children: Charles Schwab is expanding its direct Bitcoin and Ethereum services, including phased external wallet transfers. The move brings digital asset ownership further into the company’s conventional brokerage experience.
Charles Schwab is moving its cryptocurrency service closer to the features customers expect from a dedicated digital asset platform.

The brokerage has been rolling out direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading to eligible clients, and its latest account documentation explains how approved customers can transfer supported assets to and from external wallets.
For Schwab, that is a meaningful step beyond providing market exposure inside an investment account.
Buying Crypto Is Only The Beginning
Brokerage customers increasingly want to decide whether to hold digital assets with a financial institution or move them to another approved custody arrangement.
Schwab’s transfer functionality is being introduced in phases. Users must meet identity verification requirements and may encounter security checks and waiting periods for approved wallet addresses.

The platform also continues to distinguish cryptocurrency from conventional insured bank deposits. The value of Bitcoin and Ethereum is not protected by FDIC insurance merely because the assets are held through a Schwab service.
As NewsBTC reported when Schwab introduced direct crypto trading, the rollout has been deliberately gradual.

Schwab already has millions of brokerage relationships and well-established infrastructure. Adding cryptocurrency ownership makes those relationships increasingly valuable in a market where digital asset exchanges are competing with conventional financial firms.
The company has also discussed expanding its supported assets beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum.
The wider trend is clear: investors are increasingly being offered cryptocurrency services through the same institutions they use for stocks and other financial products.
The competitive question is no longer simply whether traditional brokerages will support cryptocurrency. It is how much of the customer experience they intend to control.
Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

title: Charles Schwab Opens Bitcoin And Ethereum Transfers As Crypto Rollout Expands
